integrity: A complete all-parameter proof and source comparison are supplied; finite Python tests independently corroborate boundary and example cases, not infinite generality.
scientific_limitations: Only static VC dimension for all-equal size-four partitions; no adaptive dimension or complete polynomial. The m=2 case overlaps an earlier two-block theorem. Independent verification and global priority certification are not performed.
title: Exact VC dimension of uniform four-block pair-equality concepts
